title: Later Liang Dynasty
capsule: The Later Liang (907-923) was the first of the Five Dynasties that controlled northern China after the fall of the Tang. It was founded by Zhu Wen (Emperor Taizu), the warlord who deposed the last Tang emperor, with its capital at Kaifeng/Luoyang. Constantly at war with the rival Shatuo Turk power in Shanxi, it was destroyed in 923 by Li Cunxu, who founded the Later Tang.
